bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
out="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
{
 echo '## CreateVdobot creator menu runtime readback'
 echo 'Request: req_20261115055600000000c095'
 printf 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE='; docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
 printf 'RUNTIME_IMAGE='; docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
 printf 'RUNTIME_STATE='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
 printf 'RUNTIME_RESTART_COUNT='; docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING
 printf 'BASE_COMPOSE_EXISTS='; test -f /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml && echo YES || echo NO
 printf 'STAGING_EXISTS='; test -d /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot/.worktrees/creator-menu-20261115 && echo YES || echo NO
 printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
} > "$out"
gh issue comment 1 --repo seigo-gace/create-videobot --body-file "$out" >/dev/null
echo CREATOR_MENU_RUNTIME_READBACK_PUBLISHED=PASS
